target: forge.sh — regression for the 020 build triage: the GitLab HTTP status must reach the caller (check's 401 fail line, pr-create's error message), never abort on an unbound status variable
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj.git
export FORGE_TOKEN=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0001
fx_http "GET /api/v4/user" 401 '{"message":"401 Unauthorized"}'
fx_run check; fx_show chk
printf '%s\n' "$FX_OUT" | grep -q $'^fail\t.*401' && echo "chk_fail401=yes" || echo "chk_fail401=no"
L="GET /api/v4/projects/grp%2Fproj/merge_requests?source_branch=feat&state=opened"
fx_http "$L" 200 '[]'
fx_http "POST /api/v4/projects/grp%2Fproj/merge_requests" 500 '{"message":"boom"}'
fx_run pr-create --head feat --base main --title T --body-file body.md; fx_show pc
echo "reqs=$(fx_nreq)"
fx_done
